description: Companies, people and prices are fictional. Fixtures: evals/fixtures/tokens-site (a token file, one older banner with literals), evals/fixtures/tokens-none (no token file, literals everywhere), evals/fixtures/tokens-tailwind (Tailwind v4 with the spacing and text namespaces reset). Work on a copy of the fixture, committed to a fresh git repo so --changed separates new lines from old ones. 'The check' means python3 skills/ui-tokens/scripts/check_tokens.py --changed <copy>. Run each eval 3 times, with and without the skill.

evals.prompt: add a testimonials section with three short quotes under 'What we make' in evals/fixtures/tokens-site/index.html. Quotes: 'They fitted the stairs in two days.' (Ruth, Acomb), 'The wardrobe fits the eaves exactly.' (Dev, Clifton), 'Clean, tidy and on time.' (Maria, Heworth)
evals.expected_output: A new section whose spacing, type, colours and radius come only from tokens.css, with the check clean on the new lines and the token file unchanged.
assertions: The check reports 0 errors on lines added by the change
No new px, rem or hex literal appears in a margin, padding, gap, font-size, color, background or border-radius declaration outside tokens.css
Every var(--…) the change uses is declared in tokens.css (in particular no --space-7 or --space-9)
The values of existing tokens in tokens.css are unchanged
The three quotes and names appear verbatim

evals.prompt: the card titles in evals/fixtures/tokens-site feel cramped against the text below, add about 13px of space under them
evals.expected_output: The gap under .card h3 uses an existing step (var(--space-3) 12px or var(--space-4) 16px), or, if neither fits, a new named token; never 13px. The reply says which step and why.
assertions: styles.css contains no 13px and no 0.8125rem
The space under the card titles uses var(--space-3), var(--space-4) or a new token declared in tokens.css with a role name
If a new token was added, the reply gives its name, value, role and why no existing step fit
The reply names the step used

evals.prompt: the 'Book a visit' button in evals/fixtures/tokens-site is too small, make it bigger
evals.expected_output: The button's own padding and font size move to larger existing steps or a button token; the global scale stays as it was.
assertions: The values of --space-2, --space-4 and --text-small in tokens.css are unchanged
The .button rule uses tokens for padding and font-size (existing ones, or new button tokens declared in tokens.css)
The check reports 0 errors on lines added by the change

evals.prompt: add a second line to the promo banner at the top of evals/fixtures/tokens-site/index.html: 'Free measuring within the York ring road.'
evals.expected_output: The new line uses tokens. The older .legacy-promo literals are reported as a finding, not rewritten, because nobody asked for a refactor.
assertions: The .legacy-promo declarations (22px 18px, 30px, #efe6d6, #444, 15px, 7px) are unchanged, or the reply explicitly asks before changing them
Any CSS added for the new line uses tokens only
The reply mentions the older literals in .legacy-promo as a finding left as it is
The new sentence appears verbatim

evals.prompt: add a short FAQ section (3 questions about appointments, cancellations and parking) to evals/fixtures/tokens-none. make up nothing about the clinic, leave answers as placeholders for the owner
evals.expected_output: Before the section, a token file with a spacing scale, type roles, colours and radius derived from the values the stylesheet already uses; the FAQ uses only those tokens; the reply shows which existing values were snapped to which step.
assertions: A token file exists (e.g. tokens.css or a :root block at the top of styles.css) declaring spacing, font-size, colour and radius tokens before the FAQ CSS
The token values are traceable to the existing stylesheet (e.g. #0f766e and #52606d among the colours, steps near the existing 20-22px gaps) rather than an unrelated new set
The FAQ section's CSS has no px, rem or hex literal in margin, padding, gap, font-size, color, background or border-radius
The reply lists the scale and which existing values map to which step
The existing sections are not rewritten wholesale; the reply offers the migration of the older rules as a separate step
The FAQ answers are placeholders, not invented clinic facts

evals.prompt: make the spacing between sections consistent across evals/fixtures/tokens-none, it's all over the place
evals.expected_output: This time the user asked for the refactor: a spacing scale is declared, and section padding in .hero, .section, .contact and footer moves to tokens, with a before and after count of unique spacing values.
assertions: Section-level padding in .hero, .section, .contact and footer uses var(--…) tokens
The tokens used for section spacing come from one declared scale (one token file or one :root block)
The reply gives the number of unique literal spacing values before and after (e.g. from the check's REPORT line)
Colours and type sizes are left as they were or changed only to tokens, never to new literals

evals.prompt: add a row of three pricing cards (Studio 6x3 m £18,500, Office 5x4 m £22,000, Gym 6x4 m £24,500) to evals/fixtures/tokens-tailwind/index.html
evals.expected_output: Cards built only from theme utilities that exist after the reset; no bracket values, no removed steps, no inline style.
assertions: No Tailwind class with a bracket value for spacing, text size, colour or radius (e.g. p-[…], text-[…], bg-[#…], rounded-[…])
No spacing step the theme doesn't declare (e.g. p-5, gap-10, mt-7) and no text-sm, text-lg or text-xl
No style attribute
The check reports 0 errors on lines added by the change
The three names, sizes and prices appear exactly as given

evals.prompt: the hero heading in evals/fixtures/tokens-tailwind should be 44px
evals.expected_output: Not text-[44px]. Either the existing text-h1 (48px) with the reason, or a new text role declared in @theme with a name and the reason, and a note that a 4px difference from h1 may not be worth a new role.
assertions: index.html contains no text-[44px] and no 2.75rem in a class
If a new size was added, it is declared in @theme in app.css under --text-* with a role name, and the heading uses that utility
The reply states the choice (existing text-h1 or a new role) and why

evals.prompt: Claude keeps adding random paddings and font sizes to evals/fixtures/tokens-site. set something up so it stops, for this project
evals.expected_output: The hook from references/enforcement.md set up for this project: the script copied into .claude/hooks/, a PostToolUse hook merged into .claude/settings.json or settings.local.json, and a test with a deliberate bad edit.
assertions: check_tokens.py exists under the project's .claude/hooks/
A .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json in the project registers a PostToolUse hook whose matcher covers Edit and Write and whose command runs check_tokens.py --hook
Existing settings in that file, if any, are kept
The reply says the hook was tested with an edit containing a literal (e.g. padding: 13px) and what came back, or says plainly that it couldn't be tested
The reply says the hook shows errors after the edit rather than blocking it

evals.prompt: the whole evals/fixtures/tokens-site site feels a bit cramped, loosen the spacing scale
evals.expected_output: Here the task is the scale, so changing token values is right: the space tokens grow in tokens.css, components stay on the same token names, and the reply lists what the change affects.
assertions: At least some --space-* values in tokens.css change
styles.css still references the same token names and gains no literals
The reply lists which elements or sections the changed tokens affect
The steps still grow monotonically (each --space-N is larger than the previous one)
